domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved: tofler.in returned HTTP 403, eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, trademo.com returned HTTP 403, and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable (connection refused) during this session. Domestic supply therefore recorded as unknown, not as confirmed.
note: Export side is factually supported: a dated customs record (2026-02-28) with destination France, HS 56090090 and B/L 1118675, plus a large import book (raw materials/components from Shandong Xingyu Gloves, Nanjing Tex-Express, Midas Safety Lanka/Bangladesh) — the company both imports inputs and ships finished PPE abroad, which is the pattern of a real manufacturer-exporter, not a paper trader. HS discrepancy: declared 392690 vs observed 56090090 (textile slings/lanyards) — per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground; the code should be corrected to the actual one and the verdict kept as accepted_hs_corrected. Caveat on the 11,643 figure: it is the portal's counter and mixes import and export rows; only 5 rows were visible, so do not quote 11,643 as an export count. Revenue and export value: null — not public in the free views, not invented. Domestic (India) supply: no verifiable GST/tender evidence obtained, so unknown rather than declared_only. No sanctions/court/ownership issues were researched in this pass (out of scope for this role).
